classes.talk: small talk, a greeting, a feeling or a reply that needs no fact and no tool
classes.simple: one quick answer: a fact, a short lookup or one tool call, no deliberation
classes.complex: needs careful reasoning, planning or several steps before it can be answered
classes.research: needs a deep search over many sources before it can be answered

intents.chat: to talk, share or be heard
intents.question: to know something

needs.research: a deep search over many sources

choices.description: GH #1304: a product's own questions, asked in the SAME decide call as `path`: `{<name>: {question, options: {<option>: describe}, fallback, threshold?, notes?: {<option>: text}}}`. Two options or more, and a `fallback` OUTSIDE the options, which the model is never offered; a choice that is not so is not asked. Each choice falls back on its own: an unsure path keeps it, an error, a late answer or a choice below its `threshold` (default: `threshold`) gives `fallback`. On the stamp as `choices{<name>: {value, p, source: model|fallback}}`, never empty, plus `turn_notes`: the note of each value the model chose (`source` and `id` `route.<name>`, `scope` turn, `priority` 0). `{}` (shipped) asks nothing more and the stamp keeps its seven keys.

stamp_out.description: GH #1304: "1" sends every stamp a second time as `stamp_out` -- `{turn_id, session_id, channel, audience_set, path, intent, choices, duration}`, no text and no turn notes -- which talky carries out of its rim on `stamp`. A turn without a round (no or an empty `audience_set`; `[]` is a round) raises no second stamp, fail-closed. "0" (shipped) sends nothing more; set it only where a parent draws the edge, or every turn dead-letters one message.

context_turns.description: GH #1304 (OR-EP-4): how many earlier turns OF THE PERSON, of the running generation and round, the decide call sees in a block before the turn. Above 0 the turn first asks the curator's wall (`turns_ask`, answered on `in_turns`; the read hop counts in `late_ms`). 0 (shipped): no read hop, the turn's text alone, as before.

context_budget_tokens.description: GH #1304: the token budget of that block; the wall drops the oldest turns first. Hard cap 4000 whatever is set (the decide model's window is small, 32k); 0 or less is 1500.

decide.description: the one call to `./decide`: the turn's text as `state` and the questions (`path`, `intent`, `needs.<n>`, `families.<f>`)

stamp.description: the route stamp `{turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration}` -- these seven keys, plus `choices` and `turn_notes` when the product declared `choices` (GH #1304); on `stamp_out` the rim copy `{turn_id, session_id, channel, audience_set, path, intent, choices, duration}`, without text and notes

turns_ask.description: GH #1304: on `turns_ask`, `{n, budget_tokens}` -- the read of the person's earlier turns in the curator's wall, before the decide call

asked_at.description: on `decide` and `turns_ask`: the moment of the ask in ms since the epoch, carried back through context so the stamp can say how long the decider (and the read before it) took

turn_id.description: on `stamp` and `stamp_out`: the channel turn the stamp belongs to

path.description: on `stamp`: the recommended class, the same as `stamp.path`, for an edge to test

fallback.description: on a fallback `stamp`: why it is the fallback class -- `unsure`, `error`, `late` or `no_text`; absent on a stamp the decider stands behind

state.description: GH #1304: on `turns_ask`, the turn's text, which the composite carries out and back through context, so this cell keeps no state

turns.description: GH #1304: on `in_turns`, the person's earlier turns `{turn_id, text}`, oldest first, as the curator's wall answered `turns_ask`

state.description: GH #1304: on `in_turns`, the turn's text carried back

asked_at.description: on `in_decision` and `in_turns`: the moment of the ask, carried back

description.purpose: The assistant's route cell: every turn of talky is asked ONE question set at `./decide` before the round is built, and the answer leaves as ONE route stamp `{turn_id, path, p, intent, needs, families, duration}` -- a recommendation, which the curator decides on (R-WP-1). Four classes as params: talk, simple, complex, research. A product adds its own questions (`choices`) to the same call, and may have the stamp leave the composite (`stamp_out`) and the call see the person's last turns (`context_turns`), GH #1304.
description.use_when: Inside talky, beside the collector on the keeper's `turn`. Another composite asks its own route question by giving `classes`, `intents`, `needs` and `families` of its own.
description.not_in_scope: No decision about the round: it never holds a turn back, never picks a model and never cuts a tool menu -- the curator does. No state: the moment of the ask rides on the hop and back through context.
description.emits_meaning: route decide: the call to the decider. route stamp: the stamp, with `hop.turn_id` and `hop.path` beside it. Unsure (the chosen class below `threshold`), an error of the decider, an answer later than `late_ms` or a turn without text: `fallback_class` (talk) with `p` 0, no needs, no families, and `hop.fallback` saying which of the four it was. route stamp_out (GH #1304, only with `stamp_out` "1"): the rim copy of the stamp, no text, no notes. route turns_ask (GH #1304, only with `context_turns` above 0): the read of the person's earlier turns, before the decide call.
description.consumes_meaning: `in_turn`: the keeper's turn (its user text is the state of the call). `in_decision`: the decider's `decision` (`answers`), or its error (`hop.finish_reason` `error` / `hop.error_code`). `in_turns` (GH #1304): the curator wall's answer to `turns_ask`, with the turn's text back on `hop.state`; an empty answer means the call goes on with the turn alone.
